paragraphs: Perida. R' Yose ben Perida, a Tanna; Eruvin 11b.[^1][^2]

notes.text: יא:. is rendered 11b under the colon convention, with terminal stop; no named edition is independently checked.
Perida is the current conventional rendering of פרידא, superseding the earlier Frida. Tanna is Hyman’s classification; it does not supply a fuller personal title. The abbreviated title remains R'.
